notes.title: Sorry for the lack of support!
notes.content:
Hey guys, thanks for trying out the game! Although I didn't make any money off it, engaging with the 20,000 of you made the time spent well worth it.

I'm currently no longer supporting WorldQuest, due to my commitment to a newer game I'm building. I think its even cooler, and well worth the sacrifices. Try it out when I'm done!

If you still wanna try out this game, the option to host a server is there! Just choose the option to manually/directly connect to a server when you start the game. Good luck! I'll probably come back to this at some point in the future and try and grow it again, I really do think it's a neat idea.

notes.title: Updated Servers! Reduced Lag
notes.content: Just fixed a bug in the server code that caused it to run about as fast as the slowest internet connection in the game. This should reduce lag in large games considerably, although clients with very high ping may experience a few glitches here and there. This may or may not fix the crashing bug, so the grind continues.
